\begin{exercise} \end{exercise}[Asymptotic volume of geodesic balls] 1. ch10:10-6↗ prob:taylor-series-metric-tensor ↗ prob:associated-quadratic-form

Let $p$ be a point in a Riemannian $n$-manifold $(M,g)$. Use the results of Problems 10-1 and 8-21 to show that as $r \searrow 0$, \[ \operatorname {Vol}(B_r(p)) = \frac{1}{n} a_{n-1} r^n \left( 1 - \frac{S(p) r^2}{6(n+2)} + O(r^3) \right), \] where $S(p)$ is the scalar curvature of $g$ at $p$ and $a_{n-1}$ is as in Problem 10-4. \end{exercise}
